what: The raw token counts behind the README's 'What one look costs' section and the pictures drawn by build_readme_art_r2.py.
counter: Anthropic's count_tokens endpoint (POST /v1/messages/count_tokens), which is free and makes no model call
method: Each text is sent alone as one user message and the endpoint's input_tokens is recorded (the 'raw' field below).
A user message holding only a full stop counts 9 tokens: 8 for the message wrapper and 1 for the full stop. So a text's own size is raw minus 8.
The screenshot request holds the PNG and a full stop (a message needs some text), so its own size is raw minus 9.
The tool lists are counted by apps/mcp/scripts/count-tokens-ci.ts: each list's request minus a baseline request with one tiny tool.
